item.title: International Student Program reforms controlled growth, fell short on improving integrity: Auditor General of Canada | Indo-Canadian Voice
item.description: A report from Auditor General Karen Hogan tabled on Monday in the House of Commons concludes that Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada reduced the number of new post-secondary study permits issued to control the growth of the International Student Program but that the department’s efforts to strengthen integrity measures had fallen short in key areas.

item.description: THE Integrated Homicide Investigation Team (IHIT) on Tuesday announced that 45-year-old Darcy Robb has been charged in relation to the death of a man at a Maple Ridge last week.
